description: Land Title Settlement Department - Niwandama, Ja-Ela D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 512203
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land title registration under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title to a specific parcel of land (Parcel No. 33, Block 06) with detailed land particulars including location, extent, owner details, and title classification. This falls squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it deals with land registration and title matters.
